audio2tool.conditioning_caveat: cell membership is a function of the OUTCOME of both arms, so every conditioned number is conditioned on a POST-TREATMENT variable and can carry selection (collider) bias. The conditioned cells are DESCRIPTIVE mechanism readings, never effect sizes, and a small-n cell is a mechanism reading whatever its interval says.
audio2tool.exposure_label: SECONDARY READING on the EXPOSED A2T-G1-104 subset (campaign plan section 3.3): every number is a secondary reading and can never be a campaign claim; the claim interval needs n >= 400 UNEXPOSED and belongs to G2.

ab_split.a_definition: the two DISCORDANT cells, where the arms' matching outcomes differ: extraction movement inside them is mechanically downstream of the matching movement
ab_split.b_definition: the two CONCORDANT cells, where both arms share a matching status: no matching movement can explain any extraction movement inside them

joint_decomposition_exact_match.note: the JOINT partition uses one shared weight vector for both arms, so every cell delta is PAIRED over the same samples and the aggregate delta apportions across cells with no reweighting residue. The (a)/(b) split above is therefore the primary attribution: (a) is the discordant (matching-attributable) contribution and (b) the concordant (matching-independent) one. The MARGINAL Oaxaca decomposition beside it is a cross-check on a DIFFERENT partition whose within-group term compares two DIFFERENT sample sets, which is why the two views can name different dominant terms.

audio2tool.structural_containment: reproduction.toolcall_scoring.score_item computes exact_match as equality of the full name-plus-argument multiset and tool_accuracy as equality of the tool-NAME multiset, so exact_match == 1 STRUCTURALLY implies tool_accuracy == 1. Extraction is therefore identically zero in every cell for the arm that failed matching -- asserted per sample, not assumed.

bootstrap.procedure: analysis.bootstrap.paired_cluster_bootstrap via analysis.dev100_reviewer_audit.bootstrap_gain for difference-of-per-sample-value statistics, and via a local statistic closure for the micro-aggregated ratio statistics; 90% and 95% percentile CIs, identical seed and N to the DEV-500 and DEV-1000 reads.

fidelity_gate.semantics: re-score per sample through the SAME imported scoring path the flown reads used and reproduce the already-landed aggregates to the sample and to full float precision (byte equality of the doubles). A mismatch is fail-closed.

hard_stop: This read is DESCRIPTIVE. It authorizes NO knob change, NO re-tune, NO re-flight, NO revision or restatement of the DEV-1000 LOCK, NO test contact, NO generality or superiority claim, NO G2 opening and NO Stage-3 activity. The SLURP unexposed-500 conditioned statistics are a SECONDARY reading on the locked baseline's population; the A2T numbers are a secondary reading on an EXPOSED population at n=104.
question: these tasks decompose into MATCHING (pick the right intent / the right tool) and EXTRACTION (pull structured content out of the signal). Every campaign so far reported and optimized MATCHING only. Does the supply serve EXTRACTION, on either carrier, once matching is conditioned on?

joint_decomposition_slot_f1_exact_mean.note: the JOINT partition uses one shared weight vector for both arms, so every cell delta is PAIRED over the same samples and the aggregate delta apportions across cells with no reweighting residue. The (a)/(b) split above is therefore the primary attribution: (a) is the discordant (matching-attributable) contribution and (b) the concordant (matching-independent) one. The MARGINAL Oaxaca decomposition beside it is a cross-check on a DIFFERENT partition whose within-group term compares two DIFFERENT sample sets, which is why the two views can name different dominant terms.

mirror_ordering.definition: (a) = (p_BLEND - p_M0) * (mu_BLEND_matched - mu_BLEND_unmatched); (b) = p_M0 * (mu_BLEND_matched - mu_M0_matched) + (1 - p_M0) * (mu_BLEND_unmatched - mu_M0_unmatched)
mirror_ordering.verdict: (b) THE NET WITHIN-CELL EXTRACTION EFFECT DOMINATES

marginal_decomposition_slot_f1_exact_mea.path_dependence_note: a two-term Oaxaca decomposition is path dependent; both weighting orders are published and the verdict is only reported as settled when it holds under both.

primary_ordering.definition: (a) = (p_BLEND - p_M0) * (mu_M0_matched - mu_M0_unmatched); (b) = p_BLEND * (mu_BLEND_matched - mu_M0_matched) + (1 - p_BLEND) * (mu_BLEND_unmatched - mu_M0_unmatched)
primary_ordering.verdict: (b) THE NET WITHIN-CELL EXTRACTION EFFECT DOMINATES

marginal_decomposition_slot_f1_exact_mea.verdict: (b) THE NET WITHIN-CELL EXTRACTION EFFECT DOMINATES
